name: High-Velocity Startup Full-Stack SaaS MVP Stack
target_audience: Founders, Solo Hackers, Full-Stack Engineers & Early-Stage Startups
summary: Production-ready, rapid-iteration web application architecture unifying Next.js React 19, FastAPI async microservices, Supabase PostgreSQL with RLS, Better-Auth identity, and self-hosted Coolify deployment.
architecture_overview: Early-stage startups fail when architecture is too fragile or over-engineered. This blueprint balances instant velocity with enterprise maintainability: Next.js + shadcn/ui provides clean typography and design tokens; FastAPI delivers async Python power for AI integrations and type-safe APIs; Supabase provides managed PostgreSQL with Row Level Security; Better-Auth delivers flexible session management; and Coolify allows self-hosting on a cheap VPS with one-click Git push deployments.

tiers.name: Modern Frontend & UI Component System
tiers.purpose: Server-rendered responsive UI with accessible components and design tokens.

primary_component.role: React 19 full-stack application framework with App Router and Server Components
primary_component.why_chosen: Industry standard for SEO, server actions, instant routing, and React ecosystem dominance.
primary_component.trade_offs: Vercel vendor-lock subtleties around serverless caching; complex App Router mental model.

alternative_components.role: Radix-based unstyled copy-paste UI component primitives
alternative_components.trade_offs: Code lives directly in your project; you maintain component updates yourself.
HTML class verbosity requiring disciplined design token abstractions.

tiers.name: High-Performance Backend API & Business Logic
tiers.purpose: Asynchronous REST/WebSocket endpoints, background jobs, and AI/ML model orchestration.

primary_component.role: Async Python web framework with automated OpenAPI schemas and Pydantic validation
primary_component.why_chosen: Direct native access to Python AI/data libraries, sub-millisecond serialization, and auto-generated Swagger UI.
primary_component.trade_offs: Requires separate ASGI server process (uvicorn/gunicorn) when decoupled from frontend.

alternative_components.role: Production cookiecutter template with Celery, Postgres, and Docker
alternative_components.trade_offs: Opinionated boilerplate with extra legacy services.

tiers.name: Transactional Relational Database & ORM Layer
tiers.purpose: ACID-compliant transactional storage, schema migrations, and relational indexing.

primary_component.role: Open-source PostgreSQL platform with realtime subscriptions, storage, and Row Level Security (RLS)
primary_component.why_chosen: Standard PostgreSQL under the hood, instant REST/GraphQL APIs, built-in storage buckets, and zero lock-in.
primary_component.trade_offs: Heavy local Docker footprint when running full self-hosted Supabase suite.

alternative_components.role: Lightweight TypeScript SQL-first ORM with zero overhead
alternative_components.trade_offs: Requires manual query writing compared to ActiveRecord-style abstraction.

alternative_components.role: Declarative schema modeling and type-safe query generation
alternative_components.trade_offs: Custom Rust query engine binary with higher memory consumption.

tiers.name: Authentication & Session Management
tiers.purpose: Secure multi-tenant authentication, OAuth providers, session tokens, and RBAC permissions.

primary_component.role: Comprehensive TypeScript authentication library with 2FA, social OAuth, and organization tenancy
primary_component.why_chosen: Modern, framework-agnostic, plugin-driven architecture with native Next.js server actions and database adapters.
primary_component.trade_offs: Relatively newer entrant compared to NextAuth/Auth.js, rapid ecosystem development.

alternative_components.trade_offs: Tightly bound to Supabase DB schema conventions.

tiers.name: Self-Hosted Cloud Deployment & Container Platform
tiers.purpose: Automated Git push deployments, SSL certificates, database backups, and reverse proxy routing.

primary_component.role: Self-hosted all-in-one PaaS alternative to Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel
primary_component.why_chosen: Run on any cheap Linux VPS (Hetzner, DigitalOcean), zero per-seat markup, automatic Let's Encrypt SSL, and Git webhook deployments.
primary_component.trade_offs: Self-hosted infrastructure responsibility; requires basic Linux sysadmin awareness.

alternative_components.trade_offs: AGPL v3 license considerations for enterprise redistribution.

end_to_end_workflow: Client Browser Request -> Next.js Edge SSR / Static Hydration -> Better-Auth Session Validation -> FastAPI Async Business Logic -> Supabase PostgreSQL (RLS Enforced) -> Automated Docker CI/CD via Coolify

data_flow_stages.title: Client Navigation & Responsive SSR
data_flow_stages.input: User URL request and browser session cookie
data_flow_stages.output: HTML stream with pre-rendered server components and shadcn UI widgets
data_flow_stages.verification: Lighthouse audit: LCP < 1.8s, CLS = 0, Accessibility score = 100.

data_flow_stages.title: Authentication & Tenant Boundary Check
data_flow_stages.output: Validated user profile with tenant organization and role claims
data_flow_stages.verification: Verify JWT signature, revocation list check, and CSRF token alignment.

data_flow_stages.title: Business Logic Execution & DB Mutation
data_flow_stages.input: Validated Pydantic payload from client form action
data_flow_stages.output: ACID transactional database write and updated record response
data_flow_stages.verification: PostgreSQL Row Level Security policy guarantees zero cross-tenant data leaks.

data_flow_stages.title: Continuous Deployment & SSL Routing
data_flow_stages.output: Multi-stage Docker build, zero-downtime container swap, and SSL cert renewal
data_flow_stages.verification: Automated HTTP health check probe returns 200 OK before routing cutover.

production_readiness.sla_target: 99.95% web application uptime with p95 API response latency < 120ms
security_considerations: Strict PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on all tables by default
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie flags on session tokens
Automated rate limiting via FastAPI middleware against brute-force endpoints
CORS restricted to authorized frontend origins only

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Database connection pool exhaustion under sudden traffic surge
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Deploy PgBouncer transaction pooling built into Supabase architecture.

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Single VPS server failure running Coolify
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Schedule automated hourly SQLite and PostgreSQL snapshots to offsite S3/MinIO bucket.

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Long-running AI tasks blocking web server worker threads
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Offload async work to Celery or Redis/BullMQ background queue worker.
